title: Q-STD-openssf-scorecard: read the OpenSSF Scorecard for the public repositories and file what falls
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --adopted openssf-scorecard
**Status:** open

Add one weekly workflow (header comments `# budget:`, `# trigger:`, `# free-alternative:`; the action pinned by commit SHA; public repositories only, so no private minutes) that runs the OpenSSF Scorecard action and publishes the result. Add a detector in doctrine/detectors.json that reads the published score with a GET (user agent ultrastable-audit/1.0) and fails when a check the system already claims (Pinned-Dependencies, Token-Permissions, Dangerous-Workflow) scores below its recorded floor, so the failure audit files the item. The floors are data and only rise.

STANDARDS-FIRST-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): "Standards, don't reinvent the wheel. Apply standards." The row is `openssf-scorecard` in seed/standards/standards.json; this item closes when that row reads `"adoption": "adopted"` and every probe on it passes. Change the row in the same change that makes it true, never before.
